findings.claim: Submodule pointer is committed in a dirty state (`04a945e...-dirty`), recording a tree that does not exist upstream and cannot be checked out cleanly by anyone else.
findings.evidence: Diff hunk: `-Subproject commit 1c40eaa08da210cbe3e20a77c5db211712b5c3a1` / `+Subproject commit 04a945e5078a68e79f11c4bf4d44b2a38917112d-dirty`. The `-dirty` suffix means the submodule had uncommitted local changes when the parent repo staged it.
findings.suggested_fix: Commit/clean the submodule's working tree, push it, then re-stage the clean commit pointer; or revert the submodule pointer entirely since it is out of scope for this change.

findings.claim: The change contains 16 file deletions under `.windsurf/`, violating acceptance criterion 1.2 ('Confirm no file outside .agent/.agents/.cursor/.opencode is in this change') and 2.1 ('zero modified files under the four harness trees' scope).
findings.evidence: Diff deletes `.windsurf/skills/openspec-*/SKILL.md` (8 files) and `.windsurf/workflows/opsx-*.md` (8 files). `.windsurf` is not one of the four harness trees named in criteria 1.2/2.1 or in 'What Changes' ('40 SKILL.md mirrors + 30 command/workflow files across .agent, .agents, .cursor, .opencode').
findings.suggested_fix: Split the `.windsurf` deletions into their own change with its own justification, or revert them; the deletion of the entire vendored OpenSpec Windsurf surface is a separate decision from the 1.3.1→1.10.0 mirror upgrade.

findings.claim: The change includes edits to `.prometheus/knowledge/wiki/` (index.md, log.md, and a timestamp rewrite of kimi-desktop-extensibility-executor-completion-unknown-change.md), which are outside the declared scope and violate criterion 1.2.
findings.evidence: Criteria 1.2/2.1 restrict the change to `.agent/.agents/.cursor/.opencode`; the diff's first three hunks touch only `.prometheus/knowledge/wiki/*`, none of which is a harness mirror tree.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the wiki churn from this commit; it is autonomous agent bookkeeping unrelated to the OpenSpec 1.10.0 mirror adoption.

findings.claim: The diff contains none of the 70 files the change exists to adopt — zero files under `.agent/`, `.agents/`, `.cursor/`, or `.opencode` are modified, so the stated purpose (generatedBy 1.3.1→1.10.0 upgrade adoption) is not implemented at all.
findings.evidence: 'What Changes': 'Adopt 70 modified files: 40 SKILL.md mirrors + 30 command/workflow files across .agent, .agents, .cursor, .opencode.' The diff's only skill/workflow content is deletions in `.windsurf/` still stamped `generatedBy: "1.3.1"`; no added/modified file carries 1.10.0 content, `--store`, `allowed-tools`, or schemas/view features, so criteria 1.1, 1.3, and 2.2 cannot be satisfied by this diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the actual 70 upgraded mirror files from the four harness trees in this commit, or re-scope the change description to match what is actually being committed.

findings.claim: Deleting the Windsurf OpenSpec skills/workflows outright is a regression of the harness surface with no replacement, contradicting the change's stated intent of *upgrading* vendored trees.
findings.evidence: All 16 `.windsurf` hunks are `deleted file mode 100644` with no corresponding additions. The phase target is 'change-drift-400-openspec-110-upgrade' and 'Why' says 'An openspec update rewrote the vendored harness trees... Adopting it deliberately' — deletion is not adoption, and nothing in the acceptance criteria authorizes removing the Windsurf mirror.
findings.suggested_fix: If the Windsurf mirror should track 1.10.0, regenerate it via the openspec update path; if Windsurf support is being dropped, that decision needs its own change and documentation.
